name: Trade war & tariffs
summary: China extended its rare-earth control pause to 10 Jan 2027 on 9 Nov, hours before it lapsed; truce stays short-term
state: China's commerce ministry extended its suspension of new rare-earth export controls to 10 Jan 2027 on 9 Nov, shortly before the pause was due to lapse (The Star; ThePrint). The extension keeps the US–China truce in place for two months, with a Trump–Xi meeting expected at APEC in Shenzhen. Watch is kept with an easing trend while the truce remains short-term.
for_you: Tariff truces affect import prices for electronics and other goods. Further extensions or lapses tend to move retail prices over months.
rubric_hit: Major tariffs threatened between large economies, currently suspended = Watch

why: Tariffs raise prices, reroute supply chains and slow growth; escalation cycles hurt export-heavy economies like the UK's partners.
drivers: US tariff policy, retaliation, court rulings, trade deals, WTO disputes.

rubric.alert: Broad new tariffs in force with retaliation under way, or US average effective tariff rising sharply.
rubric.watch: New major tariffs announced or threatened between large economies.
rubric.normal: Tariff regime stable; no new major measures in the past two weeks.
